name: Barbell Seated Alternating Leg Raise
steps: Sit near the front edge of a bench with your legs extended forward and press a light barbell overhead in a wide, balanced grip.
Brace your abs firmly and keep your spine tall with locked arms directly above your shoulders.
Lift one straight leg smoothly upward from your hip while keeping your torso still and the bar steady.
Lower that leg slowly back down, then raise the opposite leg, alternating sides on each repetition.
tips: Keep your elbows locked and avoid leaning backward as each leg rises.
Use a light load so you can hold the bar steadily centered above your shoulders.
